findings.evidence: `HopfKernelPoints.lean:76`, `:86`, `:127`, and `:140` are unannotated; `HopfAlgebra/Kernel.lean:105-107` has `@[simp] theorem ker_toIdeal`, while the wrapped base APIs are simp rules at `HopfMap.lean:152-160` and `HopfIdealPoints.lean:62-77`.
findings.fix: Add equivalent `@[simp]` restatements whose left-hand sides are already simp-normal, e.g. using the `RingHom.ker` quotient spelling forced by `ker_toIdeal` or pointwise normal forms, and keep the semantic `.toIdeal` lemmas as explicit rewrite aliases if desired.
findings.issue: The public computation/inclusion rules for `quotientKerPointsMulEquiv` are plain theorems at lines 76, 86, 127, and 140, so `simp` cannot normalize applications of the new equivalence or its quotient-points inclusion.

summary: The new point-level equivalence exposes the needed characteristic statements, but its computation and inclusion rules are not available as simp-normal API. Downstream users still have to manually unfold or rewrite the wrappers instead of relying on the public interface.
